method: Fresh written scenario responses against the frozen 1.9.0-rc.1 source, followed by a different agent reviewing each batch against unchanged original acceptance criteria. Initial writers received prompts without expected fields or historical responses; revisions use explicit review feedback with initial attempts retained. Shared batch context: not 170 isolated end-to-end model trials, installed host discovery, real SillyTavern execution or driver acceptance.
